title: Overcoming the World, Testimony Concerning the Son of God

questions.question: Everyone who believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of ____, and everyone who loves the Father loves whoever has been born of him.
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:1 (ESV): "Everyone who believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God, and everyone who loves the Father loves whoever has been born of him."

questions.question: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God and obey his ____.
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:2 (ESV): "By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God and obey his commandments."

questions.question: For this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments. And his commandments are not ____.
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:3 (ESV): "For this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments. And his commandments are not burdensome."

questions.question: For everyone who has been born of God overcomes the world. And this is the victory that has overcome the world—our ____.
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:4 (ESV): "For everyone who has been born of God overcomes the world. And this is the victory that has overcome the world—our faith."

questions.question: Who is it that overcomes the world except the one who ____ that Jesus is the Son of God?
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:5 (ESV): "Who is it that overcomes the world except the one who believes that Jesus is the Son of God?"

questions.question: This is he who came by water and blood—Jesus Christ; not by the water only but by the water and the blood. And the ____ is the one who testifies, because the ____ is the truth.
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:6 (ESV): "This is he who came by water and blood—Jesus Christ; not by the water only but by the water and the blood. And the Spirit is the one who testifies, because the Spirit is the truth."

questions.question: For there are three that testify: the Spirit and the water and the blood; and these three ____.
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:7-8 (ESV): "For there are three that testify: the Spirit and the water and the blood; and these three agree."

questions.question: If we receive the testimony of men, the testimony of ____ is greater, for this is the testimony of ____ that he has borne concerning his Son.
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:9 (ESV): "If we receive the testimony of men, the testimony of God is greater, for this is the testimony of God that he has borne concerning his Son."

questions.question: And this is the testimony, that God gave us ____ life, and this life is in his Son.
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:11 (ESV): "And this is the testimony, that God gave us eternal life, and this life is in his Son."

questions.question: Whoever has the Son has ____; whoever does not have the Son of God does not have ____.
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:12 (ESV): "Whoever has the Son has life; whoever does not have the Son of God does not have life."

questions.question: I write these things to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, that you may ____ that you have eternal life.
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:13 (ESV): "I write these things to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, that you may know that you have eternal life."

questions.question: And this is the confidence that we have toward him, that if we ask anything according to his ____ he hears us.
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:14 (ESV): "And this is the confidence that we have toward him, that if we ask anything according to his will he hears us."

questions.question: And if we know that he hears us in whatever we ask, we know that we have the ____ that we have asked of him.
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:15 (ESV): "And if we know that he hears us in whatever we ask, we know that we have the requests that we have asked of him."

questions.question: We know that everyone who has been born of God does not keep on ____, but he who was born of God protects him, and the evil one does not touch him.
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:18 (ESV): "We know that everyone who has been born of God does not keep on sinning, but he who was born of God protects him, and the evil one does not touch him."

questions.question: Little children, keep yourselves from ____.
questions.explanation: 1 John 5:21 (ESV): "Little children, keep yourselves from idols."

key_verse_text: I write these things to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, that you may know that you have eternal life.
